modifications: Replace active skill and quickstart with agent-authored image-conditioned Blender GLB reconstruction and staged Godot acceptance; add canonical skill installer and one external machine-wide Godot coordinator shared by fork and project callers. Legacy Three.js resources retained for attribution, not default runtime.
installationIdentity: Installer records exact resource SHA-256 inventory/content digest, fork source repository/revision and external coordinator dependency in .img2godot-install.json. Pin the fork commit in deployment records after verification; upstreamRevision is the base, not the modified fork commit. Source archives require an explicit verified --source-revision; retain exact content hashes for uncommitted-source identity.

coordinator.versionIdentity: Each .godot-coordinator-install.json records the exact source repository, source revision, source path and SHA-256 of the unchanged installed runtime bytes. The version directory is that SHA-256; the skill inventory marker records the exact dependency.
coordinator.releaseStatus: Verified scoped coordinator integration; not asset art, full-game visual acceptance or device-budget acceptance. Resolve the immutable release tag to its exact commit and record that commit externally in deployment receipts.

assetProvenance: Each asset records immutable source paths/hashes, exact allowed texture processing algorithms and output hashes, authored spec/build hashes, measured GLB facts and hash-bound image reviews. Repository provenance does not replace asset provenance.
